verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a generative video platform and API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no batch endpoint, multi-item selection, or bulk-apply feature. Luma Skills (a workflow run repeatedly), Agents for multi-step workflows, and dedicated-throughput capacity are adjacent features, not documented operations across many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
